ra: Reitia is the principal deity of the Venetic pantheon, head of the Este sanctuary cult.
Sainas is a Venetic divine name attested within the Venetic votive-cult sphere.
Trumusijatis is a Venetic deity of the Lagole sanctuary, part of the Venetic pantheon.
Ategnatis is a Venetic divine name belonging to the Venetic votive pantheon.
Pora is a Venetic divine name belonging to the Venetic votive pantheon.
Reitia's healing and protective-of-women functions led to her functional identification with Greek Artemis in interpretatio.
Under Romanization the Este sanctuary cult of Reitia was assimilated toward Diana (Artemis' Roman counterpart).
Reitia's role as patron of writing/literacy (votive alphabet tablets) aligns her functionally with Minerva's craft-and-learning sphere.
Trumusijatis shares the curative-cult sphere of the Venetic sanctuaries headed by Reitia, linking the thermal-spring healing deity to the great healing goddess.
